verify_detail: NOT SHIP\nTwo of the app's five core flows — Checkout (wrong/undisclosed totals) and Form (silently drops the selected Tier) — produce incorrect data that would reach a backend or a customer's receipt in a real product. Combined with a validation-free promo code path and a main-thread stall in a user-facing action, this is not ship-ready; it needs the Checkout pricing logic rewritten, Form's Tier binding fixed, Redeem given real validation, and Rebuild index moved off the UI thread, at minimum."
